baseline.method: Independent original published-method run on exact public observations; agreement reference, not physical truth

reference_role: Method agreement only; real observations have no independently known truth.
threshold_provenance: Fixed before local extraction; independent reruns with identical bound observations and conventions are deterministic. A nonzero1e-6 numerical floor is conservative; differing precision conventions are documented sensitivity experiments, not repeat errors.

observation_consistency.interpretation: AIA uses the declared nominal-response/adopted-error model; KiDS compares shear at the declared two-pixel Gaussian resolution with zero DC. Neither implies independently known physical truth.
